## Plugin reference

- Description: The decisions.open mandate capability as plain data. A leaf, so a mandate author (mandate-presets, reached from conversations) can grant it without a cycle through decisions, which imports tasks-core and conversations.
- Core:
  - Uses: `tasks/orchestration/mandate/policy.defineCapability`
  - Exports (values): `decisionsOpen`
- Cross-plugin:
  - Imported by:
    - `tasks/decisions`
    - `tasks/mandate-presets`
    - `tasks/supervisor-roles`
